title: Biomédico
description:
Nova oportunidade para Biomédico em cubatão. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Responsabilidades   Analisam amostras de materiais biológicos, bromatológicos e ambientais. Para tanto coletam e preparam amostras e materiais. Selecionam equipamentos e insumos, visando o melhor resultado das análises finais para posterior liberação e emissão de laudos. Desenvolvem pesquisas técnico-científicas. Atuam em bancos de sangue e de células tronco hematopoiéticas. Operam equipamentos de diagnósticos por imagem e de radioterapia. Participam na produção de vacinas, biofármacos e reagentes. Executam reprodução assistida e circulação extracorpórea. Podem prestar assessoria e consultoria técnico-científica. Trabalham seguindo normas e procedimentos de boas práticas específicas de sua área de atuação.  Processar os exames do laboratório.  Realizar coleta e preparo de materiais.  Receber, triar, conferir, centrifugar e distribuir para os setores amostras biológicas para análises.  Executar procedimentos atribuídos a sua bancada, priorizando a liberação dos resultados.  Liberação dos resultados dos exames após análise do controle de qualidade, análise de exame e correlações clínicas.  Monitorar as pendências de coleta e/ou resultados de exames.  Realizar e avaliar o controle de qualidade interno e externo dos exames realizados.  Controlar, acompanhar e registrar as manutenções preventivas e corretivas dos equipamentos.  Realizar a manutenção dos equipamentos.  Digitar mapas de trabalho, quando não interfaceados, e liberar exames no interfaceamento.  Efetuar o controle de estoque e pedido de materiais, considerando o consumo/perdas de cada item utilizado no setor.  Prestar esclarecimentos de exames aos médicos e aos pacientes.  Ser responsável pelo laboratório e/ou posto de coleta, garantindo o bom funcionamento do laboratório.  Arquivar dados brutos (mapas de trabalho, planilhas, relatórios) do seu setor.  Implantar e executar programas e ferramentas da qualidade assegurando a padronização.  Exercer o papel de multiplicador, estimulando e repassando conhecimentos técnicos e científicos e treinando os novos colaboradores.  Dar apoio aos colaboradores em dúvidas técnicas e esclarecimento de dúvidas a clientes.  Auxiliar nos processos do SGQ inerentes às suas áreas.  Comunicar-se com os clientes para discutir resultados, fazer recomendações e agendar testes/recoletas adicionais, se necessário.  Garantir o registro preciso dos dados cadastrais e o monitoramento dos procedimentos dos pacientes, e também de possíveis amostras de UBS/CLÍNICAS/PARCEIROS entre outros.  Manter registros de estoque e atualizar equipamentos e suprimentos.  Manter controle de temperaturas, POPs, certificados de calibração/validação de equipamentos/instrumentos disponíveis.  Coordenar a equipe técnica para agendar testes e garantir que os procedimentos adequados sejam seguidos.  Gerenciar contas de clientes e manter registros atualizados.  Realização de pesquisas sobre novos métodos para melhorar a eficiência e a precisão e rotina da unidade.  Garantir a conformidade com todos os protocolos de segurança e rotinas.  Supervisar/liderar equipe, fornecendo instruções e feedback sobre os procedimentos, protocolos, rotinas, instruções da diretoria e de treinamentos/reuniões diversos.  Cumprir com as leis e regulamentos federais, estaduais e locais aplicáveis em relação às operações de laboratório.  Garantir a organização de todo o ambiente de trabalho, desde rotinas de limpeza, manutenção de equipamentos, funcionamento da unidade e rotinas diversas.  Possuir habilidades de liderança para gerenciar sua equipe, o que inclui delegar tarefas, fornecer feedback e motivar os funcionários a seguir os protocolos de segurança e manter a limpeza do laboratório.  Habilidades de comunicação eficazes para o contato com diferentes partes interessadas, incluindo equipe de laboratório, fornecedores, executivos e clientes.  Habilidades de resolução de problemas: identificar e resolver problemas que ocorrem no laboratório e solucionar problemas de equipamentos/dia-a-dia.    Requisitos   Escolaridade: Graduação  Habilidade Técnica  INFORMATICA - Básico  Conhecimento no sistema Shift - Básico  Trabalho em equipe - Intermediário  Domínio de técnicas laboratoriais - Intermediário  Proativo com Iniciativa - Intermediário  Capacidade de concentração e percepção - Intermediário  Capacidade de trabalhar e liderar equipe - Intermediário        Benefícios   Vale alimentação  Vale transporte  Telemedicina  TotalPAss    Localização  Rua Armando de Salles Oliveira, Centro, Cubatão - SP, Brasil,     #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Regional Lobby Manager São Paulo
description:
Confira a vaga para Regional Lobby Manager São Paulo em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Reporting to the Head of Games Operations, the Regional Lobby Manager will be responsible for the end-to-end management and optimisation of games lobbies across our LATAM markets, with a primary focus on Brazil and Mexico.  The Regional Lobby Manager will manage the sporty games lobby, ensuring optimal game positioning, effective promotions, strong supplier alignment, and high-quality internal reporting. The role plays a critical part in shaping the player experience and driving performance across the region.  What you'll be doing   Own and manage the sporty games lobby across all core LATAM markets (including BR and MX), ensuring optimal game positioning aligned with commercial strategy and player behaviour  Maximise visibility and discoverability of key games, promotions, and new releases within LATAM lobbies  Upload, schedule, and maintain promotional banners and in-lobby content, ensuring accuracy, relevance, and timely execution  Configure and maintain game settings, limits, and parameters in line with product, commercial, and regulatory requirements  Act as the regional point of contact for supplier needs related to lobby management, promotions, and releases  Partner closely with Product and Tech teams on testing, new feature rollouts, and improvements to categorisation and navigation  Optimise localisation across LATAM markets, ensuring content, naming, and presentation are culturally and linguistically appropriate  Use a data-driven approach to monitor lobby performance, player engagement, and promotional effectiveness, turning insights into actionable improvements  Produce and share clear internal feedback, performance updates, and reports to support decision-making across teams  Manage games-related escalations and operational queries, ensuring timely resolution and effective communication  Plan, coordinate, and map new game releases across LATAM markets, with a particular focus on sporty games  Align closely with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure all lobby content and configurations meet local regulatory requirements  Collaborate on release plans with internal studios and third-party suppliers to ensure smooth execution and strong regional impact    What you'll bring   Proven experience working with online casino games, ideally in lobby management, games operations, or content optimisation  Strong understanding of the LATAM market, particularly Brazil; local market knowledge is highly desirable  Analytical and data-driven mindset, with the ability to interpret performance data and make informed recommendations  Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively with globally distributed teams  Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience working with suppliers and internal partners  Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, operational environment with competing priorities    What's in it for you   A competitive salary + individual performance based bonuses every quarter  28 days paid annual leave  Top of the line equipment  Annual company retreats to provide great internal networking opportunities    If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.  Sporty is committed to protecting your personal data and ensuring transparent, compliant handling of all information you provide during the application process. Your data will be processed in accordance with applicable privacy laws and retained securely. For details, please review our Privacy Policy.  We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Afinidade e desejo de aprender e aplicar uma nova gama de habilidades, especialmente em marketing e vendas. Conectado(a) com diversos grupos e indivíduos influentes no campus. title: [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí
description:
Empresa está contratando [ 18/09/2025 ] Almoradí se suma al Día Mundial de la Limpieza Almoradí em santos. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí  El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí, a través de la Concejalía de Medio Ambiente que dirige Domingo Andreu  y con el respaldo de la alcaldesa María Gómez , organiza este fin de semana dos citas destacadas en torno a la sostenibilidad y el cuidado del entorno. El sábado 20 de septiembre  la Plaza de la Constitución  acogerá, de 10 a 13:30 horas, la XIII Jornada Medioambiental de Almoradí , un evento ya consolidado en el calendario local. La programación incluye talleres para todas las edades, como “Descubre el mundo de los bichos”, “Plantas aromáticas”, “Huertos urbanos” o “Recicla por el clima”. También habrá exposición de fósiles y minerales, intercambio de ropa sostenible y actividades de concienciación sobre reciclaje y uso responsable de recursos. La jornada contará además con la participación de la Concejalía de Protección Animal, cuyo responsable Víctor Argilés  ha anunciado la presencia de Esprineco , empresa contratada por el Ayuntamiento y centro en el que se encuentran los animales recogidos en la vía pública. Durante la feria se mostrarán algunos de ellos con el objetivo de darles visibilidad y facilitar su adopción. Por su parte, desde la Concejalía de Participación Ciudadana, también dirigida por Víctor Argilés , se instalará un stand donde se realizarán encuestas y se recogerán sugerencias y propuestas vecinales, fomentando así la implicación ciudadana en la mejora del municipio. El domingo 21 de septiembre , Almoradí se sumará al World Clean Up Day , Día Mundial de la Limpieza, en una acción simultánea que se llevará a cabo en varios municipios de la Vega Baja. La actividad está promovida por las asociaciones Vega Baja Limpia  y Mocho Costero , y en el caso de Almoradí tendrá como punto de encuentro el Auditorio Municipal (Calle Torrevieja, 3)  a las 10:00 horas . Desde allí los participantes recorrerán la Ruta del Agua  en una batida de limpieza ciudadana. El Ayuntamiento de Almoradí invita a toda la ciudadanía a participar en estas actividades que buscan sensibilizar sobre la importancia de la sostenibilidad, la protección animal, la reducción de residuos y la conservación del entorno natural. La construcción de este proyecto por parte de TM Grupo Inmobiliario supone una inversión de 140 millones de euros y la generación de miles de empleos directos e indirectos en la ciudad Compártelo: Haz clic (...)   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Data Engineer ID43407
description:
Confira a vaga para Data Engineer ID43407 em curitiba. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Role  As a Senior Data Engineer , you’ll play a key role in shaping high-impact data solutions that power smarter decision-making and support a global mission to connect people with meaningful work. You’ll collaborate with diverse teams to build secure, scalable pipelines and drive innovation in cloud-based data infrastructure. This is a chance to grow technically, influence product evolution, and thrive in an open, collaborative culture that values learning and excellence.  What You Will Do   Develop and maintain secure and efficient data pipelines using DBT, PySpark, and Python in an Indeed-supported cloud environment, integrating all HR data sources to enable analytics and insights for HR COEs and HR leadership.  Build the infrastructure and tooling required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) of data from various sources using Python, DBT, Terraform, and AWS technologies such as Glue, EMR, and S3.  Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements, including automating manual workflows, debugging and optimizing data delivery, and re-architecting infrastructure for enhanced scalability.  Apply the Data Quality Framework in the HRDM repository by developing unit tests, and creating both manual and automated test cases.  Monitor data pipelines to ensure a minimum of 99.5% data availability.  Create and maintain data models that are intuitive and easily consumable by business partners.  Write and update project documentation (most data ingestion scripts are written in Python).    Must Haves   5+ years of experience working as a Data Engineer.  Python for object-oriented programming and data scripting.  Experience with Snowflake.  Strong SQL experience.  Experience using DBT for data transformations.  Experience with Airflow.  Experience with REST API for integration and data ingestion.  Experience with Google BigQuery.  Handling large-scale and sensitive data securely. title: Brazil Business Development Manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Brazil Business Development Manager em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Khan Academy is a fast‑paced nonprofit with a mission to provide a free, world‑class education to anyone, anywhere. Our proven learning platform offers high‑quality, supplemental content and practice—free of charge—covering core academic subjects from Pre‑K through 12th grade and early college, with a strong focus on math and science. We serve over 200 million registered learners across 190 countries and 55 languages, and we are committed to improving learning outcomes for students worldwide, especially those in historically under‑resourced communities. For more information, please see research findings about Khan Academy and our press center.  OUR COMMUNITY  Our students, teachers, and parents come from all walks of life, and so do we. Our team includes people from academia, education, big tech companies, and startups. We hire great people from diverse backgrounds and experiences because it makes our company stronger. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging as necessary to achieve our mission and impact the communities we serve. We know that transforming education starts in‑house with learning about ourselves and our colleagues. We strive to be world‑class in investing in our people and commit to developing you as a professional.  KHAN ACADEMY BRAZIL  Khan Academy Brazil delivers a world‑class experience, locally relevant with content, programs, and resources for students, teachers, schools, and districts. Our platform is a supplemental digital learning resource that provides interactive, mastery‑based activities for K–12 students in Math, Portuguese, and Science—all aligned with the BNCC. We serve over 11 million learners across our website, apps, and YouTube channels, and our goal is to scale impact through deeper partnerships with public districts and school systems.  ABOUT THE ROLE  Khan Academy Brazil is seeking a Business Development Manager focused on Government Growth to join a small, mission‑driven, highly collaborative team with a big goal: expanding Khan Academy’s reach in Brazilian public education through strategic partnerships and public procurement. This role blends public‑sector business development, partnership strategy, bidding processes, and project management. You will build and manage a pipeline of opportunities with public districts, lead end‑to‑end bid processes, and use our prior partnership experience with school systems as proof points to drive expansion to other districts. If you are comfortable moving between strategic conversations with public education leaders and deep dives into RFPs, bid documents, and implementation details, this role is for you.  Your key responsibilities  Strategic growth   Design and scale partnership models with public districts, aligning Khan Academy’s pedagogical, technological, and financial value proposition with district's priorities  Use our prior partnership experience with public school systems as reference cases, structuring learnings, evidence, and narratives that can be replicated with other districts  Support local leadership in growth strategy for public districts, including sales and marketing efforts, coordinating proposals, presentations, and relationship strategies  Support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts when relevant, including contributing to proposals, reports, or relationship management    Public‑sector pipeline and bids   Build and manage a structured pipeline of public sector opportunities, mapping priority cities and states, upcoming tenders and public calls, and partnership opportunities  Act proactively in demand generation and pre‑tender influence, where appropriate and compliant, contributing with technical input and reference models  Lead or coordinate the full cycle of public bid responses, including:  Analyzing RFPs, bid documents, terms of reference, and draft contracts  Assessing risks and legal/compliance alignment in close collaboration with legal, finance, and other functional areas  Defining commercial models, scopes, timelines, and success criteria  Preparing and consolidating technical, pedagogical, financial, and institutional documentation  Track timelines, deliverables, clarifications, and potential appeals or challenges throughout the bidding process, in close collaboration with internal and external partners    Implementation and impact   Manage end-to‑end priority partnerships with public school systems, ensuring strong implementation that drives reach, engagement, and measurable learning outcomes for students and educators  Work closely with Khan's partnership functions to design implementation, training, and support plans tailored to each district and use quantitative and qualitative data to track key metrics and propose course corrections  Translate implementation learnings into playbooks for future partnerships with public systems, collaborating with local and international teams to iterate and scale best practices    Stakeholder and relationship building   Build and maintain trust‑based relationships with decision makers in public districts (pedagogical, technical, procurement teams, among others), navigating complex political and institutional environments with empathy, strategic insight, and integrity, in order to drive change management and system‑level adoption of Khan Academy  When relevant, support philanthropic and corporate partnership efforts (funders, foundations, corporate CSR) especially when connected to programs with public districts  Act as a champion for public‑sector partners, educators, and students inside Khan Academy, bringing structured feedback to content, product, support, and strategy teams    ABOUT YOU  What you bring   10+ years of relevant experience in education, business development, consulting, sales to government, public‑sector programs, or large‑scale partnerships, with proven experience selling to or managing contracts with the public sector, ideally in education or govtech, including exposure to public procurement processes and interaction with oversight bodies  At least 3 years managing institutional partner relationships (e.g., customer success, account management, public‑sector program management) and leading complex projects or multi‑stakeholder implementations with clear, measurable outcomes  Strong business development and account management acumen, including the ability to identify new opportunities, build trust with institutional partners, and support proposal and sales cycles in the public sector  Excellent project and program management skills, with a track record of executing high‑impact initiatives across multiple districts or partners simultaneously  Advanced collaboration and influence skills, able to align internal and external stakeholders, manage cross‑functional dependencies, and drive progress without formal authority  Strong strategic and adaptive problem‑solving, able to navigate ambiguity, co‑create solutions with district leaders, and iterate based on evolving needs and political contexts  Excellent communication skills across formats and audiences, including emails, briefs, presentations, and verbal interactions with senior education leaders and technical teams  Comfort and fluency working with qualitative and quantitative data, including analyzing trends, interpreting dashboards, and extracting insights to inform decisions  Outstanding organization and time‑management abilities, capable of coordinating multiple workstreams with high attention to detail  Professionalism, discretion, and integrity, especially when managing sensitive partnerships or navigating politically complex environments  Residency in, or willingness to relocate to, São Paulo, with legal authorization to work in Brazil  Fluency in Portuguese and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills in both languages    You would be a great fit if you have   Experience working with public education systems, NGOs, or government organizations, with a strong understanding of the realities and needs of teachers, school leaders, and district administrators  Demonstrated passion for education equity and innovation, with a commitment to supporting public schools and underserved communities  Proficiency with productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and project management platforms (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana, or similar)  Familiarity with AI‑powered tools for content creation, data analysis, or workflow efficiency, with curiosity about leveraging technology to improve educational outcomes  Coaching and facilitation skills, with the ability to support capacity‑building in school systems through empathetic guidance, strategic questioning, and constructive feedback  Experience with or exposure to philanthropic partnerships or CSR initiatives, especially those connected to public education    What is nice to have   Classroom teaching experience, preferably in K–12 settings, which provides valuable perspective when engaging with educators and supporting implementation  First‑hand experience using Khan Academy with students, with insight into how the platform supports instruction differentiation and learning personalization    PERKS AND BENEFITS  We may be a nonprofit, but we take great care of our team. You can expect:   Competitive compensation with healthcare and life insurance benefits  Flexible schedules and generous time off, including personal days beyond standard vacation  A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning  An exceptional team that trusts you, supports you, and gives you autonomy to do your best work  The opportunity to apply your talents to a meaningful mission, contributing to high‑impact offerings that are shaping the future of education  A kind, inclusive, and welcoming workplace, with affinity groups, ally networks, and social activities to help you connect and belong    Live & breathe learners  We deeply understand and empathize with our users. We leverage user insights, research, and experience to build content, products, services, and experiences that our users trust and love. Our success is defined by the success of our learners and educators.  Take a stand  As a company, we have conviction in our aspirational point of view of how education will evolve. The work we do is in service to moving towards that point of view. However, we also listen, learn and flex in the face of new data, and commit to evolving this point of view as the industry and our users evolve.  Embrace diverse perspectives  We are a diverse community. We seek out and embrace a diversity of voices, perspectives and life experiences leading to stronger, more inclusive teams and better outcomes. As individuals, we are committed to bringing up tough topics and leaning into different points of view with curiosity. We actively listen, learn and collaborate to gain a shared understanding. When a decision is made, we commit to moving forward as a united team.  Work responsibly and sustainably  We understand that achieving our audacious mission is a marathon, so we set realistic timelines and we focus on delivery that also links to the bigger picture. As a non‑profit, we are supported by the generosity of donors as well as strategic partners, and understand our responsibility to our finite resources. We spend every dollar as though it were our own. We are responsible for the impact we have on the world and to each other. We ensure our team and company stay healthy and financially sustainable.  Bring out the joy  We are committed to making learning a joyful process. This informs what we build for our users and the culture we co‑create with our teammates, partners and donors.  Cultivate learning mindset  We believe in the power of growth for learners and for ourselves. We constantly learn and teach to improve our offerings, ourselves, and our organization. We learn from our mistakes and aren’t afraid to fail. We don't let past failures or successes stop us from taking future bold action and achieving our goals.  Deliver wow  We insist on high standards and deliver delightful, effective end‑to‑end experiences that our users can rely on. We choose to focus on fewer things — each of which aligns to our ambitious vision — so we can deliver high-quality experiences that accelerate positive measurable learning with our strategic partners.  HOW TO APPLY   Attach your resume or Linkedin URL in the space provided below.  Please address the below‑mentioned task and attach your response in the space provided below.    TASK  Describe a public‑sector partnership or bid process where you played a leading role. In your answer, briefly cover:   The context and goal of the opportunity  The key actions you led (e.g., stakeholder engagement, proposal/bid work, internal alignment)  The outcome and one key learning    Please anonymize any confidential information and limit your response to one page.  We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or Veteran status. We value diversity, equity, and inclusion, and we encourage candidates from historically underrepresented groups to apply.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Banco de Talentos Finanças
description:

Feita de pessoas que transformam a educação. Todas as vagas da Arco são elegíveis para Pessoas com Deficiência. Estamos em busca de talentos para atuar em nosso time financeiro! Se você busca desafios em um ambiente dinâmico e quer contribuir com o crescimento estratégico da empresa, essa é a sua chance. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e impulsionar sua carreira! Envie seu currículo e faça parte dessa jornada! Áreas de Atuação Administrativo/Viagens: A Magia de Organizar o Mundo! Nosso time de Viagens vai além da logística e dos relatórios de viagem — somos mestres na arte de conectar pessoas, destinos e oportunidades de forma eficiente. Contabilidade: A Arte de Contar Histórias com Números! Para além dos balanços e demonstrações financeiras — somos contadores de histórias através de números. Compras: A Estratégia de Encontrar Oportunidades no Mercado! Nossa equipe de Compras vai além de negociar e adquirir produtos — somos especialistas em identificar as melhores oportunidades de mercado. Contas a Pagar: A Responsabilidade de Garantir a Saúde Financeira! Além de processar pagamentos — somos responsáveis por manter o fluxo financeiro da empresa sempre em dia. Contas a Receber: Garantindo o Fluxo de Receitas da Empresa! Registrar pagamentos é somente um pedaço do que fazemos — somos responsáveis por assegurar que os recebimentos fluam de forma eficiente. Controladoria: O Coração da Governança Financeira! Somos os guardiões da precisão e da integridade financeira da empresa. Controles Internos: Garantindo a Eficiência e Segurança dos Processos! Nossa equipe vai além de monitorar processos — somos responsáveis por assegurar que as operações da empresa aconteçam de forma eficiente. Crédito e Cobrança: Contribuindo para o Sucesso Financeiro da Empresa! Nosso objetivo é garantir a saúde financeira da empresa, mantendo um fluxo de caixa estável e eficiente. Fiscal/Tributário: Desvendando o Mundo dos Impostos! Esse time é especialista em navegar pelo complexo universo da legislação fiscal. P&A (Planejamento Financeiro e Análise): Onde a Estratégia Financeira Ganha Vida! No time de FP&A, você será parte essencial da construção de cenários e projeções que direcionam as decisões estratégicas da empresa. Funding: Impulsionando o Crescimento da Empresa! Nós captamos recursos e muito mais — somos responsáveis por garantir que a empresa tenha o financiamento necessário para impulsionar seu crescimento. RGM (Revenue Growth Management): Estratégia para Maximizar o Crescimento da Receita! Além de analisar dados financeiros — somos responsáveis por desenvolver estratégias que impulsionem o crescimento sustentável da receita. M&A (Fusões e Aquisições): Ajudando a Construir o Futuro da Empresa! Esse time está sempre em busca de novas oportunidades de crescimento. Tesouraria: Gestão Eficiente do Fluxo de Caixa! Somos feras em gerenciar os recursos financeiros — somos responsáveis por garantir que a empresa tenha sempre o capital necessário para suas operações.  Requisitos Residir em uma de nossas cidades base (Curitiba, São Paulo, Fortaleza) ou ter disponibilidade para mudança; Possuir experiência na área financeira.  Competências Desejadas Bons conhecimentos em ferramentas de dados como Excel e BI; Capacidade de agir de forma autônoma e buscar soluções criativas para problemas; Boa comunicação e capacidade de construir pontes relacionais com diferentes áreas; Habilidade para interpretar dados, elaborar relatórios e contribuir para a tomada de decisões; Capacidade de lidar com mudanças e desafios em um ambiente corporativo, adaptando-se rapidamente aos novos cenários; Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver; Versatilidade para lidar com múltiplas tarefas.  Diferenciais Inglês fluente obrigatório para a área de M&A; Conhecimento em linguagem de programação como SQL, Python, VBA, C++, etc.  Benefícios Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição Plano de saúde e odontológico Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida Auxílio creche para mães Cuidado com a saúde física: parceria com a Gympass Incentivo à educação Desconto em passagens aéreas  Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial. Por isso, aqui na Arco, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Enfermeiro(a) Serviços Hospitalares | Banco de Talentos Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver! QUEM SOMOS: A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente. Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes. Enfermeiro(a) - Serviços Hospitalares  O que você irá realizar: Cumprir os processos e atividades de assistência aos pacientes em programa de diálise domiciliar e/ou hospitalar com diagnóstico de injúria renal aguda em recuperação, crônica ou crônica-agudizada submetidos às modalidades de Terapia Renal Substitutiva (TRS), visando garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas no tratamento dialítico incluindo o uso adequado de equipamentos de proteção individual, o cumprimento às rotinas e normas técnicas, operacionais e administrativas estabelecidas pela Franqueadora e legislação vigente, bem como a garantia da sua segurança no ambiente de trabalho. Bem como ser o facilitador no dia a dia do tratamento domiciliar, através de comunicação direta e precisa com o médico nefrologista e o Enfermeiro Supervisor SH responsáveis pelo paciente, atuando como elo da prestação de serviços SH e o acompanhamento durante o a sessão dialítica, condições clínicas e adequação do paciente e da família ao tratamento proposto. Esperamos que você tenha: Formação em Enfermagem e pós graduação em Nefrologia concluída. Registro no Órgão competente ativo (COREN); Experiência na área de Nefrologia e CTI; Disponibilidade de horário; Desejável conhecimento no pacote Office e em informática; Habilidade no relacionamento interpessoal e no trato com pessoas;  Informações complementares: Local de trabalho: São Paulo - SP Unidades em vários locais. title: Narrative Designer | Talent Pool
description:
Empresa está contratando Narrative Designer | Talent Pool em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

We are ARVORE, a startup in the virtual reality content creation scene. Based in São Paulo, our studio creates, designs, produces, and develops world-class interactive experiences and games for all current and future high-end immersive platforms, including virtual reality, augmented reality, and mixed reality. ARVORE is looking to hire a technically adept, creative individual to complement our team. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative immersive and narrative-driven XR experiences, iterating and prototyping with a high level of creative freedom and with the opportunity to guide the direction of some of these endeavors. Our process emphasizes teamwork, agility, and multidisciplinarity. We are seeking a passionate and self-motivated person with a positive attitude and a genuine team spirit, who enjoys sharing knowledge and is open to learning from others. We embrace problem solvers, those unafraid to experiment and fail, and who are ready to create something new. JOB DESCRIPTION ARVORE seeks a creative NARRATIVE DESIGNER  to design the narrative elements of our experiences and to champion story within the development process. When designing a narrative, we all know the golden rule: “show, don’t tell”. In interactive content, we may also add “do, don’t show”. The Narrative Designer must think in actions and interactions, inviting the audience to take actions and immerse their bodies within a story. It is crucial to consider the medium and the user’s body when designing a VR experience. The ND's role is to ensure that interactions and narrative work seamlessly, considering the specificities of each project. MAIN CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ACTIVITIES: Conceive, create, and advocate for appropriate narrative features within the team, writing narrative content and ensuring it is embraced by the final product; Develop documents and tools that materialize the project's narrative content, such as emotion curves, beat sheets, synopses, mind maps, screenplays, and similar tools; Create descriptions and backstories for characters, locations, objects, and events, collaborating with the Production Design team and the creative director to develop worldbuilding systems; Collaborate with the Development team to create real-time tools for implementing the narrative content in the experience; Work with the Game Design team and Creative Director to define the flow of events, overseeing dialogues, animations, audio, event timings, props, etc.; Create functional documentation to keep the team and stakeholders informed about the narrative elements; Ensure the project is understandable and cohesive from the user’s perspective, following and reporting on user tests; Produce summaries of the narrative content for distribution, such as festival registrations and pitch decks; Build a repertoire of narrative VR experiences and present new immersive experiences to the team.  MUST HAVE: Exceptional writing ability; Fluency in Portuguese and English; Willingness to observe, absorb, and modify their work per project needs; Strong interpersonal skills for effective communication across disciplines; Previous experience in narrative content creation teams; Constantly seeking to learn new skills and expand their repertoire; Ability to give and receive constructive and creative feedback; Deep understanding of narrative structures, plot beats, emotional progression, and classical storytelling elements; Ability to balance narrative, interaction, and ludology aspects in immersive experiences, integrating story and gameplay; Passion for movies, TV, visual arts, literature, theater, and great stories across media; Experience in scriptwriting for film, TV, or games; Technical or Bachelor of Arts degree in Cinema, Media, Creative Writing, Literature, or equivalent practical experience; Openness to learning new methods and frameworks.  NICE TO HAVE: Familiarity with Google G Suite and screenwriting software; Previous experience with VR and AR content; Experience working in a studio or production company; Video game industry experience; A passion for Virtual Reality.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Introduction Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. Overview Gallagher is a global leader in insurance, risk management and consulting services. We help businesses grow, communities thrive and people prosper. We live a culture defined by The Gallagher Way, our set of shared values and guiding tenets. A culture driven by our people, over 50,000 strong, serving our clients with customized solutions that will protect them and fuel their futures. Arthur J. Gallagher is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Senior Accounting Analyst  to join our team for a systems implementation project, deploying JDE ERP/GL/AP/PO/FA, Kyriba (Treasury), Circulus (AP Automation) and Concur (T&E). This role will play a critical part in ensuring the successful integration of accounting systems, processes, and controls. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in accounting, financial analysis, and systems implementation, with the ability to collaborate across departments to achieve project goals. How you\'ll make an impact Systems Implementation Support:Assist in the implementation and integration of new accounting systems for Accounting (General Ledger, Chart of Accounts), Finance, Fixed Assets, Accounts Receivable, Trade and Non-Trade Accounts Payable, Procurement, Treasury Management (Kyriba), Tax, Master Data, Travel & Expense (Concur), Operations, and other business areas. Collaborate with IT and project teams to ensure accounting requirements are accurately captured and incorporated into system design. Participate in system testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure functionality aligns with accounting standards and business needs.   Process Improvement:Analyze current accounting processes and identify opportunities for automation and efficiency improvements. Develop and document new workflows and procedures related to the implemented systems.   Data Migration and Reconciliation:Support data migration efforts, ensuring accuracy and completeness of financial data transferred to the new financial systems. Perform reconciliations to validate data integrity post-migration.   Training and Documentation:Provide training and support to accounting staff on the new system functionalities. Create detailed documentation for system processes, workflows, and user guides.   Brazil Localization, Controls & Compliance:Ensure system design meets Brazilian accounting, tax and regulatory requirements (e.g., SPED ECD/ECF, withholding taxes, ICMS / ISS/ IOF / PIS / COFINS, CNAB banking files), aligning with global accounting policies (IFRS/US GAAP) and internal control frameworks (SOX, Segregation of Duties). Review impacts on financial close, reconciliations, tax calculations and audit requirements. Validate rules related to taxes, reporting, electronic documents, and other local obligations. Assist in preparing financial reports and analyses during the transition period.   Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with stakeholders across Corporate and Local accounting teams, IT, implementation partner and operations to ensure alignment and smooth implementation. Act as a liaison between accounting and technical teams to address system-related issues.    About you Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA or equivalent certification is a plus. 3+ years of experience in accounting, financial analysis, or related roles. Solid grounding in Accounting/Finance processes (period close, accruals, reconciliations, AP/AR, T&E), with understanding of IFRS/US GAAP; Brazil statutory/tax familiarity is essential. Proven experience implementing systems such as JDE, Kyriba, Concur or AP automation tools. Experience with integrations, data migration and banking processes. Understanding of Brazilian tax and accounting rules is required. Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems (e.g., JDE, SAP, Oracle, Workday). Advanced Excel skills and familiarity with data analysis tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work with global teams in different time zones. Languages: English – mandatory; Portuguese – mandatory; Spanish – fluency is a strong advantage. Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid).    #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Sobre a Diaverum: A Diaverum é a empresa líder a nível internacional na prestação de cuidados renais, com foco em melhorar a vida renal dos pacientes - permitindo-lhes viver uma vida plena. A nossa experiência em cuidados renais remonta há mais de 25 anos e temos estado na vanguarda do setor desde então. As nossas operações abrangem atualmente 24 países, com mais de 14.000 funcionários motivados que atendem uma base de pacientes de mais de 40.000 indivíduos. Atividades:  Fornece terapia de diálise crônica, incluindo, mas não se limitando à formulação de um plano de diálise com ultra filtração, iniciando a diálise através de vários acessos, cumprindo as medidas de segurança e monitorando os sinais vitais do paciente aplicáveis aos pacientes com insuficiência renal crônica de acordo com o Plano de Cuidados. Prepara e administra medicamentos, fluido terapia ou outros tratamentos apropriados por prescrição médica e realiza as respectivas documentações no prontuário do paciente. Analisa dados do paciente; avalia e monitoriza o status dos acessos vasculares, revisa resultados laboratoriais, avaliações de pacientes e relata quaisquer alterações ou anormalidades relevantes ao médico plantonista. Monitoriza o sistema de tratamento de água de diálise para uso de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos. Montar e verificar o funcionamento dos aparelhos de hemodiálise, garantindo que todos os dispositivos estejam limpos, funcionais e calibrados. Avaliar as condições clínicas do paciente antes e após a sessão, incluindo sinais vitais e acesso vascular. Observar continuamente os sinais vitais e os parâmetros do aparelho durante a hemodiálise para garantir a eficácia e a segurança do tratamento, ajustar o fluxo sanguíneo e os parâmetros da máquina conforme necessário. Realizar uma avaliação inicial detalhada, coletando informações sobre sintomas, histórico médico e alterações recentes no estado de saúde. Inspecionar e cuidar do acesso vascular para prevenir infecções e complicações, instruir o paciente sobre cuidados domiciliares com o acesso. Manter registros detalhados sobre o tratamento, incluindo dados vitais, parâmetros da máquina, e qualquer evento adverso. Assegurar que a documentação seja completa e precisa. Relatar alterações no estado do paciente e resultados das sessões à equipe médica e outros profissionais de saúde envolvidos no cuidado. Assegurar que todos os procedimentos sejam realizados de acordo com as normas e protocolos estabelecidos pela Diaverum Brasil. Fornece educação continuada ao paciente e respectivo prestador de cuidados. Participa proativamente em programas de melhoria de qualidade.  Requisitos:  Graduação em Enfermagem; Registro no COREN; Experiência em procedimentos hospitalares e Hemodiálise; Especialização em Nefrologia (desejável).  Local:  Jardim Guarulhos Conheça mais sobre a Diaverum no site:    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Descrição da vaga  A Shoulder é uma marca pronta a vestir a mulher brasileira e transformá-la em sua melhor versão!  Estamos com diversas oportunidades afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência em diferentes áreas administrativas. Aqui valorizamos a diversidade, oferecemos um ambiente participativo com desenvolvimento e aprendizagem constante.  Acreditamos no seu talento e queremos despertar em você sua melhor versão!  Responsabilidades e atribuições   Apoio a equipe com demandas da área;  Preenchimento de planilhas, documentos e atualizações nos sistemas internos;  Apoiar no atendimento aos colaboradores esclarecendo dúvidas e procedimentos da área;  Entre outras atividades administrativas pertinentes à cada área de atuação (diversas).    Requisitos e qualificações   Ensino médio completo ou graduação em andamento ou concluída em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Logística, Ciências Contábeis e correlatas;  Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horário comercial;  Ter fácil acesso ao Centro de São Paulo.    Essa é a Shoulder: Lugar que dá vontade de ficar.  Tudo começa com a nossa Roupa boa®.   Desde os anos 80, a Shoulder veste o tempo da mulher que vive em evolução. Estamos com ela na rotina, no trabalho e até nos momentos mais especiais. Somos desejo, qualidade e conforto - sempre de um jeito sofisticado. Tudo bem “vestiu e foi”, tudo bem Shoulder.  Por aqui, criamos moda de um jeito inspirador e possível, pensando em cada tempo e unindo elegância e qualidade. Em cada coleção, criamos peças 100% exclusivas, que vão do 34 ao 48, nessa mistura do que é atual com o toque atemporal.  Em todo lugar, o tempo todo .  Hoje, somos mais de 90 lojas em todos os estados do país, e nosso e-commerce veste de norte a sul. Nossa presença também se estende pra mais de 1.000 multimarcas. Por isso a gente adora dizer: estamos em todo Brasil, 24h, todos os dias.  Um lugar pra querer estar.   Com mais de 1.700 colaboradores, a gente acredita que ninguém faz nada grande sozinho — e que, quando um cresce, todo mundo cresce junto.  Nossa cultura procura incentivar o propósito que vira atitude. Incentiva a escuta atenta, a presença e o cuidado em cada detalhe — da criação da nossa Roupa boa®  até a experiência em loja. Pra gente, é tudo sobre respeito, colaboração e comunicação.  Vem fazer parte também.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

A convenção vale para os trabalhadores de Caconde, Casa Branca, Cássia dos Coqueiros, Divinolândia, Itobi, Mococa, São José do Rio Pardo, Santo Antônio da Alegria, São Sebastião da Grama e Tapiratiba. Solicite a íntegra da convenção enviando um e-mail para   . Para os salários menores ou iguais a R$ 7.818,84, o índice de reajuste será de 6% sobre os salários de 30/4/2025, a ser pago a partir de 1º/5/2025. Para salários maiores que R$ 7.818,84, o reajuste corresponderá ao valor fixo de R$ 469,13, a ser pago a partir de 1º/5/2025. Haverá proporcionalidade de reajuste para os contratados entre as datas-base de 2024 e 2025, que, entretanto, não se aplica aos pisos salariais. As eventuais diferenças salariais relativas aos meses de maio de 2025, decorrentes da aplicação do reajuste, deverão ser pagas até a folha de pagamento de junho de forma destacada, sob o título “Diferença estabelecida na Convenção Coletiva maio 2025”. Os pisos são os seguintes: Trabalhadores não qualificados – serventes, contínuos, vigias, auxiliares de trabalhadores qualificados e demais trabalhadores cujas funções não demandem formação profissional: R$ 2.189,97 por mês ou R$ 9,95 por hora, para 220 horas mensais. Trabalhadores não qualificados (piso de meio-oficial) – trabalhadores em processo de qualificação, podendo permanecer até 12 meses nesta função, contados a partir da mudança de piso R$ 2.427,36 por mês ou R$ 11,03 por hora, para 220 horas mensais. Trabalhadores qualificados – pedreiro, armador, carpinteiro, pintor, gesseiro e demais profissionais qualificados não relacionados: R$ 2.664,75 por mês ou R$ 12,11 por hora, para 220 horas mensais. Trabalhadores qualificados em obras de montagem de instalações industriais – R$ 3.192,39 por mês ou R$ 14,51 por hora, para 220 horas mensais. Alimentação  O valor mínimo do tíquete refeição passa para R$ 31,80, e o vale supermercado para R$ 485,00. As cláusulas referentes a café da manhã, lanche da tarde e almoço permanecem basicamente as mesmas. O almoço será obrigatório apenas em casos excepcionais mediante acordo, e se este não ocorrer, o Seconci-SP (Serviço Social da Construção) fará a mediação. As demais cláusulas, como as referentes à jornada de trabalho, contribuição ao Seconci-SP, empreiteiros e banco de horas, permanecem as mesmas. Contribuição Assistencial  As empresas descontarão em folha de pagamento de seus empregados, sindicalizados ou não, a contribuição assistencial de 2% dos salários já reajustados, inclusive sobre o 13º salário. Os valores descontados serão repassados ao sindicato profissional até o dia 8 de cada mês. Os descontos e os recolhimentos referentes aos meses anteriores poderão ser feitos até o dia 8/6/2025. Assegura-se aos empregados o direito de oposição ao desconto da contribuição, mediante carta escrita de próprio punho, indicando nome completo do trabalhador, CPF, função, e data de admissão, nome do empregador (razão social e CNPJ). O SindusCon-SP é o representante e interlocutor qualificado das empresas da indústria da construção paulista que contribuem para o crescimento econômico, a geração de empregos e a sustentabilidade ambiental nacional. Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de novos projetos educacionais e metodologias didáticas em conjunto com a coordenação. title: Customer Onboarding Manager - (Implementation Project Manager) - Brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para Customer Onboarding Manager - (Implementation Project Manager) - Brazil em são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.  About us  Insider One is the #1 platform  that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.   Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry‑first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices . With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels , including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.  We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic . We are backed by top‑notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst , and trusted by 2000+ customers from high‑growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino’s, and the list goes on.  Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman‑foundated, women‑led B2B SaaS unicorns  in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader  in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it – see for yourself. The results speak for themselves.   From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world‑class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities  in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables , our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.  Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers  that moves fast and agile, creating cutting‑edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.  As a Customer Onboarding Manager, you will be responsible for driving the onboarding process, ensuring successful and timely outcomes for new clients. Your role is crucial in accelerating time to value and ensuring customer retention by helping clients fully integrate and realize the value of Insider One’s platform.  You will collaborate closely with internal technical resources to empower and train customers on how to use Insider One’s platform and its powerful features as efficiently as possible. Establishing strong, credible relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the client organization will be key to understanding their business and technical goals.  Role Expectations  You will be expected to have a technical background, which could be gained through either academic education or relevant work experience. This includes the ability to read API documentation, knowledge of HTML, CSS, and XML, and the ability to understand basic data structures and data flows.  You will be prioritized if you have experience with short‑to‑medium‑term projects and strong project management skills, as your role will heavily focus on managing multiple projects simultaneously.  What You Will Do   Project management of customer onboardings to ensure successful outcomes, accelerating time to value and driving customer growth and retention.  Collaborate with internal technical teams to train customers on using Insider One’s platform and features effectively.  Build credible relationships with stakeholders at all levels, from senior management to end users, to understand their business and technical goals.  Drive early adoption by setting KPIs and success metrics, ensuring full ROI for clients.  Advocate for customer business use cases with the product development team.  Ensure smooth transition to the Customer Success Manager team by documenting client stakeholder roles and hierarchy.  Continuously enhance the onboarding experience by improving processes and training materials.  Where needed, tailor 1:1 onsite and remote onboarding sessions to exceed client expectations.  Establish trust and confidence in Insider One’s platform, ensuring successful early adoption.  Coordinate effectively with client agencies and third parties to achieve desired outcomes.  Ensure the highest quality in deliverables, maintaining client satisfaction and facilitating a seamless post‑onboarding transition to the Customer Success & Support teams.  Collaborate with the development team to ensure custom development meets client expectations and standards.  Own the project, taking responsibility for successful implementation while working closely with both internal and external stakeholders.  Facilitate exceptional user‑enablement training and workshops to empower clients.    What You Will Need   Minimum of 3 years of experience in SaaS project management and client onboarding.  PM qualifications such as Agile, PMP, or Prince2 are a plus.  Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with business fluency in English.  Time and task management skills are essential.  Proven ability to communicate effectively with both internal and external stakeholders.  Demonstrated success in delivering projects in a timely and efficient manner.  Knowledge of Google Tag Manager, Google Product Feed, and Google Analytics is an advantage.  Understanding of webhooks and APIs.  Exposure to and understanding of AI‑driven product recommendation tools and algorithms is a plus.  Experience with other CRM, ERP, or marketing automation platforms is an advantage.    What We Offer   Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.  Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.  Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.  Become a Shareowner through our eligibility‑based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.  Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.  Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose‑driven social impact projects.  From global retreats to team‑building activities, expect year‑round events that turn into lifelong memories.    We aren’t just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.  To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good‑hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.  If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.  We provide equal opportunity in a zero‑discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.  Follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!    #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Estoque
description:
Confira a vaga para Analista de Estoque em barueri. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Conheça a nossa história!  Na Imex acreditamos que a inovação é a chave para um futuro mais saudável. Somos uma empresa inovadora, com uma forte presença no mercado de saúde e tecnologia. Com mais de 20 anos de história, somos especialistas nesse segmento e a nossa missão é transformar o setor de saúde por meio de equipamentos médicos de alta qualidade, tanto para uso humano quanto veterinário, atuando em todo o Brasil.  Aqui valorizamos o compromisso com resultados e a colaboração entre as pessoas. Valorizamos o comprometimento, a diversidade e a autenticidade de cada um, e acreditamos que quando todos crescem juntos, o impacto é ainda maior.  Qual será o seu papel?  Como Analista de estoque , você será responsável por analisar e otimizar os níveis de estoque, analisando dados para garantir a eficiência operacional e o atendimento às demandas de clientes internos e externos. Sendo responsável por receber, armazenar e expedir suprimentos no depósito, realizando os devidos lançamentos de movimentações a respeito de cada peça/produto recebido no almoxarifado. title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:

Cyber Security Analyst  At Landis+Gyr , we don’t just manage energy—we lead the transformation toward a smarter and more sustainable energy future.  With a net revenue of USD 1.73 billion in FY 2024 , and a presence in over 30 countries across five continents, Landis+Gyr empowers utilities and consumers to optimize energy usage through advanced metering, grid-edge intelligence, and powerful data analytics.  Today, our global team of about 6,300 professionals  is shaping the digital energy era—developing innovative technologies that support decarbonization, grid modernization, and real-time energy insights. Our record USD 4.6 billion order backlog  and strong book-to-bill ratio reflect long-term confidence in our mission and solutions.  Join us at Landis+Gyr, where we manage energy better!   Purpose and Objective  Purpose of the role is to help us to facilitate security incident response handling and contribute on enhancements of the security incident response processes and their implementation into the already existing security tools and procedures.  Key Performance Indicators  Supports and adheres to Company’s core values  Performs other duties or responsibilities as assigned or required  Supports and adheres to Company’s Code of Conduct and Ethics Policy  Represents Company in a positive, professional manner when working with both internal and external customers  Core Areas of Responsibility / Accountability   Investigate cyber security incidents and drive the remediation actions to completely remove the threats in both on-premise and cloud environments  Track the remediation actions’ progress to make sure they are followed by appropriate personnel within the expected timeframe; escape if needed  Suggest preventive actions and drive the effort to implement them globally to minimize the risk that particular security issues can occur again  Participate in incident response process enhancements, suggest changes, implement them and document  Create runbooks and workflows for specific incident types, implement them into the existing security incident tracking tool  Create reports to provide the overview of the current incident response situation as well as trending over time for various types of audience, e.g. Top-level Management, CISO, Security Team members, etc.  On-call support for Critical severity security incidents    Requirements   Advanced English (mandatory): ability to communicate fluently with global stakeholders, produce documentation and reports, and participate in meetings in English  Broad cyber security knowledge (4+ years) and experience in Incident Response area (2+ years)  Knowledge of a cloud environment (e.g. GCP, AWS, Azure)  Understanding of Cloud Security and related threats and vulnerabilities  Familiarity with common attack methodologies, tactics and protocols, Advanced Persistent Threat groups and hacker activities  Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP protocols and ISO/OSI model  Hands-on experience with ServiceNow as SecOps module admin    Education / Additional Qualifications  Minimum Bachelor’s degree in IT is preferred or equivalent knowledge  We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background.We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. #EnergizeYourCareer  and join us on our journey towards a greener tomorrow.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Growth Marketing Analyst (PLG)
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior Growth Marketing Analyst (PLG) em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

We are a global technology company specializing in digital applications and security. Our platform helps companies operate more agilely, reducing response times and increasing the reliability of their systems.  At Azion, our purpose is to simplify application development and transform the future with cutting-edge technology. Here, you will have the chance to develop in an innovative environment, alongside a high-performance team, working on real challenges and creating solutions that make a difference.  About the position  We are looking for a Senior  Growth Marketing Analyst  to join our Marketing & Growth team in our São Paulo office. As part of the Marketing & Growth team, the successful candidate will be responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing product-led growth strategies across our self-serve funnel—from acquisition and activation to monetization and retention.  You will own the experimentation roadmap, build lifecycle and in-product experiences that drive the “aha” moment and habit formation, define and operationalize PQLs, and partner closely with Product Engineering, Data, and Sales to accelerate revenue from our self-serve and product-qualified motions.  Your Impact   Own self-serve funnel KPIs (signup → activation → PQL → paid → retention) and deliver quarter-over-quarter improvements aligned to our plans and a clear North Star metric;  Build and run a rigorous experimentation program across website, onboarding, in-app paywalls, and pricing/packaging; translate results into shipped improvements;  Design and launch lifecycle programs (email, in-app, push) that guide users to activation, expand adoption, and reduce churn, leveraging segmentation and personalization;  Define PQL scoring and routing; implement lead capture, intent signals, and sales handoff processes with RevOps to enable product-led sales;  Partner with Product Engineering and Data to instrument analytics, create dashboards, and socialize insights that inform roadmap, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.    What You’ll Bring   Solid experience in B2B SaaS growth/marketing with 2–3+ years driving PLG at scale; proven impact on activation, conversion, and net revenue retention;  Strong analytical toolkit: proficiency in SQL and experimentation analysis; comfort with cohort/retention modeling, LTV/CAC, payback, and pricing/packaging tradeoffs;  Hands‑on with PLG tooling: product analytics (Amplitude/Mixpanel), CDP (Segment), marketing automation (HubSpot/Braze/Customer.io), A/B testing (Optimizely/LaunchDarkly), and web analytics (GA4/Tag Manager);  Excellent product sense and messaging skills; can craft crisp in-product copy and lifecycle communications grounded in user research and JTBD frameworks;  High‑ownership, cross‑functional collaborator who can prioritize ruthlessly, manage a backlog, and influence without authority in a fast‑paced environment.    Bonus Points   Experience with freemium or usage-based models, paywall design, and pricing experimentation;  Familiarity with modeling PQLs using scoring/ML and building referral or viral loops that compound growth.    Benefits & Azion Way of Life   CLT hiring model;  Health and dental plan;  Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;  Transport voucher without payroll deduction;  Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);  Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);  Stock options (according to policy);  Birthday day off;  TotalPass;  Flexible working hours (really flexible);  Nomad Program to work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year (according to policy);  Annual international exchange program.    FlexWork Model  We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on‑site  in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. We believe that this initial immersion not only strengthens the team, but also boosts creativity and innovation.  After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid  model, working on‑site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.  At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.  Come and join our team! We look forward to getting to know you and walking a path of success in technology together!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

No Mercado Envios administramos o estoque de nossos vendedores e entregamos os produtos aos nossos compradores, melhorando sua experiência em nossa plataforma. Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Faça parte da equipe que está liderando a logística na América Latina, oferecendo soluções customizadas de classe mundial e integrando carriers locais e regionais, através de um comércio que não reconhece fronteiras.  Temos um desafio para as pessoas que:  Vibram energia empreendedora: são movidas pela curiosidade, nunca desistem e estão focadas em superar seus próprios limites. Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação. Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros. A excelência e a execução são primordiais na sua forma de fazer as coisas. Promovem o bom clima, a alegria e a diversão. Sabem como construir com outras pessoas e desfrutam trabalhando em equipe.  Imagine você empreendendo projetos desafiadores, dinâmicos e inovadores, e sendo responsável por:  Liderar o suporte técnico remoto para sistemas de automação, robótica e PLC durante paradas de produção. Analisar incidentes complexos, diagnosticar causa raiz e coordenar a resolução sem necessidade de intervenção presencial, sempre que possível. Construir e manter uma biblioteca técnica centralizada e padronização de procedimentos, diagnóstico e solução de problemas, melhores práticas e desenhos. Utilizar monitoramento, SCADA, logs e dados históricos para ante- cipar falhas e reduzir o tempo de parada, definir e melhorar indicadores operacionais, como MTTR, SLA, taxa de deflexão e produtividade por analista. Atuar como referência técnica sênior nos fluxos de triagem, implementar e desenvolver uma sinergia com a equipe de SRE, melhorar o fluxo de escalonamento e incidentes críticos do suporte remoto. Colaborar ativamente no desenvolvimento e evolução de inteligência artificial, chatbots e automações de suporte e ser protagonista na escalabilidade do suporte LATAM, gerenciando múltiplos sites em paralelo.  Requisitos:  Possuir ensino superior completo em Engenharia de Automação, Elétrica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas. Demonstrar experiência sólida em automação industrial, manutenção ou suporte técnico remoto. Interpretar diagramas elétricos, documentar processos e atuar no diagnóstico e solução de problemas remoto de sistemas industriais. Ter conhecimento prático em PLCs como Siemens, Rockwell ou equivalentes, SCADA, IHMs, robótica industrial, redes industriais e conectividade remota, como TCP/IP, VPNs, firewalls.  Nós lhe propomos:  Ser parte de uma empresa com espírito empreendedor, na qual adoramos pensar grande e em longo prazo. Ser protagonista de seu desenvolvimento em um ambiente de oportunidades, aprendizagem, crescimento, expansão e projetos desafiadores. Compartilhar e aprender em equipe, com excelentes profissionais e especialistas. Um excelente clima de trabalho, com todo o necessário para você viver uma grande experiência. :)  O Mercado Livre não faz contato oferecendo oportunidades em troca de pagamento de dinheiro. Você tem acesso a todas as oportunidades abertas no nosso site de carreiras. Caso receba pedidos de dinheiro, desconfie!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.  Who We Are…  When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…  From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.  Your New Role  The Senior Manager, Social Media – Brazil is the strategic and operational leader responsible for shaping and driving the social media vision for HBO and HBO Max across the Brazilian market. This role oversees a team of 5–7 social media specialists ensuring the development of innovative, culturally resonant, and high‑impact social strategies that support key title launches, brand initiatives, and broader business objectives.  Acting as Brazil’s primary social media lead, this leader blends creativity with insight‑led thinking, steering day‑to‑day operations while championing long‑term planning, experimentation, and platform excellence. The Senior Manager translates global brand direction into Brazil‑first strategies, collaborating deeply with cross‑functional partners, and guiding the team in producing compelling content that captures attention, drives conversation, and fuels measurable growth.  This is a highly visible, fast‑moving role requiring a creative strategist, disciplined operator, and strong people leader who can inspire talent, influence stakeholders, and elevate the brand in one of HBO’s most important markets, and let’s face it… home of the BEST FANS IN THE WORLD. #ComeToBrazil  Your Role Accountabilities   Lead the development and execution of Brazil’s social media strategy, ensuring alignment with local marketing priorities, regional directives, and global brand standards.  Manage, mentor, and develop a high‑performing team of 5–7 social media professionals, providing clear direction, coaching, and ongoing performance management to elevate capabilities and output.  Oversee day‑to‑day content planning, publishing, and creative execution, ensuring all content reflects brand voice, drives engagement, and supports priority title campaigns.  Serve as the primary strategic partner for Brazil across cross‑functional teams (Marketing, PR, Brand, Merch, etc.), ensuring integrated communication and consistent storytelling across all touchpoints.  Translate global guidance into Brazil‑first social strategies, adapting creative approaches, formats, and messaging to maximize local relevance and cultural resonance.  Own the social performance measurement framework, partnering with Social Media Analysts & agency partners to interpret data, generate actionable insights, and guide continuous optimization across platforms.  Drive innovation by monitoring social trends, platform updates, and creator behaviors, proactively testing new formats, tools, and content approaches to keep the brand at the forefront of culture.  Oversee real‑time coverage for major premieres, events, and cultural moments, ensuring flawless execution, community responsiveness, and risk‑mitigating escalation where needed.  Lead relationships with social media agencies and external partners, ensuring seamless coordination, timely deliverables, and high‑quality creative output.  Collaborate with Paid Media teams on paid social strategy, providing guidance on creative assets, audience priorities, and measurement.  Ensure operational excellence across workflows, processes, and publishing systems, improving efficiency and establishing best practices for the Brazil team and broader region.  Represent Brazil’s social needs and insights in international alignment meetings, advocating for market‑specific strategies and opportunities across global teams.    Qualifications & Experience   Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field  Fluency in English (Spanish a plus)  Solid experience in social media, preferably in entertainment or agency settings  Proficiency with social media tools (e.g., Hootsuite, Sprout Social) and analytics platforms  Strong understanding of social media trends and best practices in Brazil  Skilled in creating reports and presenting insights  Proficiency in PowerPoint, and Excel  Experience working with budgets and forecasts  Knowledge of the entertainment industry  Passion for pop culture    How We Get Things Done…  This last bit is probably the most important! Técnico em Eletrônica, Eletrotécnica, Mecânica ou cursos profissionalizantes Senai compatíveis (Eletricista, Eletrônico, Eletrotécnico Industrial, Mecânico). Certificações obrigatórias: NR-10 (para área elétrica), NR-33 e NR-35.  Benefícios que fazem a diferença na CINPAL Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, seu desenvolvimento e o da sua família: PLR – porque acreditamos no reconhecimento pelo desempenho coletivo. Restaurante no local – alimentação prática e de qualidade para o seu dia a dia. Transporte fretado – mais comodidade e segurança no trajeto. Assistência Médica – plano comcoparticipação , possibilidade deincluir dependentes e com ampla cobertura. Assistência Odontológica (opcional) –adesão com participação fixa mensal e estendida a dependentes. Convênio com Universidades parceiras (Anhanguera e Unifecaf) – descontos exclusivos para sua formação. Parceria com SESI e SENAI – benefícios em cursos profissionalizantes, educação e lazer.  Sobre a CINPAL Fundada em 1950 na cidade de São Paulo, a CINPAL iniciou suas atividades fabricando semieixos forjados para automóveis e caminhões. Em 1964, a Companhia transferiu suas operações para Taboão da Serra. Ao longo de sua trajetória, a CINPAL buscou atender a demanda crescente do mercado de autopeças, passando a produzir também peças fundidas e usinadas até 60kg.
